method_order: rotate methods left by (profile_index + round) modulo 4; one fresh process per method/profile/round
case_order: lexicographic case_id, identical for every method and round
construction: direct symbolic graph compilation, no truth-table expansion
reordering: automatic off; sift_once uses one explicit CUDD sifting pass after root construction; all costs included
input_law: identical arbitrary joint observation categories, informative masks and integer counts
result: all six variants plus five joint contrasts, exact rational endpoints, statuses and ambiguous endpoint witnesses
cold_boundary: in-memory saved model through validation, manager construction, symbolic compile, prescribed reorder, first query and certificate construction
warm_boundary: same immutable observations queried again with ready diagram; validation and certificate construction included; no answer memoization
specialized_boundary: frozen solve(model), including validation, all variants, contrasts and certificate construction
memory_boundary: GNU time fresh worker process peak RSS across a complete profile/method/round batch; includes common input loading and untimed verification; not per-model RSS
timing_interpretation: technical repetitions of fixed empirical models, not independent scientific campaigns
full_pipeline_claim: separate from the v1 telemetry-to-forecast PMX pipeline; BDD replaces only the exact solver stage
